messages:
incidentbot: PagerDuty autopage fired for service=metrics-pipeline-prod (prometheus-scrape-fail). Severity: P1
incidentbot: alert: prometheus_job_scrape_failures_total{job="http-exporter-prod",region="ap-south-1"} > 3 for 4m
incidentbot: PD incident created PD-90021 -> auto-assigned to rotation
Leo (on-call): acked
Leo (on-call): pulling logs and kube events for exporter stack now
Ivy S (SRE): saw a micro spike in consumer lag earlier, flagging possible downstream backpressure
Alex M (platform): got infra health dashboard open, checking host network and kube node status
Leo (on-call): ```bash
kubectl -n monitoring get pods -l app=http-exporter -o wide
kubectl -n monitoring logs deploy/http-exporter -c exporter --since=10m | tail -n 200
```
Leo (on-call): exporter pods restarting repeatedly; readiness probe failing with connection timeout to /metrics
Jenna - Customer Ops: flag: two customers pinged support, dashboards blank since ~02:25Z, adding to PD notes
ops-bot: PagerDuty PD-90021 escalated to SRE rota after 5m unack
Ivy S (SRE): looking at logs — seeing repeated `OutOfMemoryError` in JVM exporter after a burst of requests, GC thrash noted
Alex M (platform): node metrics show IO errors on node k8s-node-77, dmesg shows NIC errors around 02:20Z
Robin (infra): I can drain node k8s-node-77 and reprovision if needed. Want me to cordon/drain now?
Leo (on-call): yes cordon and drain that node, then reschedule exporters onto healthy nodes. If OOM persists, scale replicas temporarily
Robin (infra): cordon/drain initiated: ```bash
kubectl cordon k8s-node-77
kubectl drain k8s-node-77 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --force
```
Ivy S (SRE): while node is draining, let's reduce scrape frequency for the affected job to reduce load and stop OOM spiral. I'll create a temporary scrape config override in prometheus
Ivy S (SRE): ```yaml
# temp patch to reduce churn
- job_name: http-exporter
  scrape_interval: 30s  # bumped to 30s from 10s
  static_configs:
    - targets: ['http-exporter.prod.svc.cluster.local:9100']
```
Leo (on-call): adding PD suppression for this rule for 45m to prevent re-autopages while we stabilize (:mute:)
pagerbot: Suppression added by Leo — 45m window for prometheus_job_scrape_failures_total in ap-south-1
Robin (infra): drain finished, exporter pods rescheduled to node k8s-node-83 and k8s-node-85
Alex M (platform): new nodes show healthy NIC, no IO errors, exporters started but one pod still OOM-killed during init
Ivy S (SRE): since we still see OOM on a pod, doing horizontal scale up + temporary resource increase. Patching HPA and resource requests for exporter
Ivy S (SRE): ```bash
kubectl -n monitoring scale deployment/http-exporter --replicas=6
kubectl -n monitoring set resources deploy/http-exporter --requests=memory=800Mi --limits=memory=1.6Gi
```
Leo (on-call): monitor consumer lag and dashboard ingestion while scaling. Alex, can you validate kafka-proxy health?
Alex M (platform): kafka-proxy healthy; consumer lag for metrics-consumer group peaked at 95k and is now decreasing to ~18k after scale and reschedule
Jenna - Customer Ops: two customers report dashboards restored, one still sees delayed metrics, adding update to status page: investigating, ETA 20m
Ivy S (SRE): prometheus now shows scrape success rate improving across targets for the job; GC pauses reduced after resource bump and scale
ops-bot: PD-90021 status update: mitigated -> monitoring. Owner: Leo (on-call)
Leo (on-call): creating follow-up ticket: INVEST-1604 to track root cause: exporter memory regression + node NIC hardware fault; assign eng-runtime and infra teams
Leo (on-call): immediate action items: ["infra: perform deeper NIC hardware diagnostics on k8s-node-77 (owner: Robin)", "eng-runtime: audit recent config and dependency bumps for exporter that could increase heap (owner: Ivy S)", "SRE: create threshold rule to autopause scrapes when pod restarts >3 in 5m (owner: Leo)"]
Jenna - Customer Ops: sending customer follow-ups, logging affected accounts and potential SLA note
Ivy S (SRE): will open PR to add canary test to deploy pipeline to detect memory regressions in exporter when we roll config changes
Leo (on-call): leaving handoff notes in PD and INVEST-1604. If stable for 30m we close PD fully. Thanks team :thumbsup:
pagerbot: PD-90021 owner changed to Leo (on-call) -> status monitoring
incidentbot: Thread archived to PD-90021 by Leo (on-call)
Leo (on-call): resolved in slack; INVEST-1604 created; moving to postmortem.
Jenna - Customer Ops: great job everyone, preparing customer summary and follow-up timeline
Alex M (platform): logging infra actions and hardware replacement schedule in INVEST-1604
Ivy S (SRE): will follow up with detailed GC logs attached to INVEST-1604
Leo (on-call): handoff complete. Closing Slack thread once PD closes.
